title: ToolRegistry
description: Every MCP tool Hermes may call, with its identity, receipt kind and UI hints.

hermes_name.description: The name Hermes uses for the tool: mcp__<server>__<id>.

family.description: The capability family a data source must grant for the tool to run.

description.description: One line for the UI saying what the tool does.

explorer.description: The UI explorer that renders the tool's receipts.

receipt_kind.description: The artifactKind of the tool's receipts.

feature.description: The agent feature (AGENT_FEATURES) that provides the tool: retrieval, analytics and ontology come with the Compose profiles of those names (analytics-gpu gives analytics), kumo with a Kumo service's URL and key.

pills.description: The technology pills the UI shows for a question or a recorded run that uses the tool.

Pill.title: Pill
Pill.description: A technology pill, in display order. cudf, cuml and cugraph are the GPU libraries of the market tools (on the CPU: pandas, scikit-learn and NetworkX); questions.yaml `tools` names these too.
